description: This receipt represents a grocery purchase from Smart & Final, a warehouse-style food and supply retailer. It displays the Smart & Final logo and tagline at the top, followed by the store address in San Diego, California, and store contact details. The receipt includes an itemized list of beverages and grocery items with individual prices, a subtotal, tax calculation, and final total. Payment is recorded as a cash transaction with change returned. Additional details include the total number of items sold, cashier identification, transaction date and time, terminal information, barcode reference, and a closing thank-you message. This format is suitable for retail receipt samples, POS system demos, expense records, and receipt generator templates.
